outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, and individual data points (colored dots per sample) are overlaid on each bar.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the experimental workflow, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographs/images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
